messages:
nina: Cutting release in 30m but CI blocked: artifact publish failing with 502 from internal registry.
ci-bot: Job 8342 logs: 
  PUT https://registry.internal/v2/blobs/uploads/: 502 Bad Gateway
  error: upload aborted
harry: 502 usually indicates registry gateway to GCS had a transient outage earlier today. Status page showed a brief incident at 10:12.
qa-bot: Flake count: 4/5 uploads failing in last 15m across different runners. Suggest pin to last good SHA to keep change window.
nina: Options: wait for registry recovery (unknown ETA) or manual promote previous artifact sha256:fa17b33. We need decision.
harry: Leaning to pin to keep customers on the planned schedule. File an incident ticket to track registry rollback and reupload later.
deploybot: Manual promote accepted. Promoting to sha256:fa17b33 by @nina at 1751237000.
ci-bot: Background task: kick reupload retry job 8343 against backup mirror.
qa-bot: Notifying PM and release-managers with note: "Temporary pin due to registry 502; will re-run artifact publish and publish an amended release if successful."
nina: Release notes entry drafted and approved. Unblocked for cut.
harry: Opening follow-up infra ticket INF-900 to harden registry gateway and add retry/backoff to publish step.
ci-bot: Promo completed; change window preserved.
